content_sections.heading: CESS Job Description
content_sections.text: In addition to being involved in Research Projects of the Centre, all the above positions (Professor / Assistant Professor) are required to be actively involved in teaching for the Ph. D Programme of the Centre and supervision of scholars.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Ph.D degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline; Minimum of 10 research publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals; Total research score of 120. Experience required: Minimum of 10 years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, or research experience at equivalent level. Pay: Level - 14 (Rs. 1,44,200 to Rs. 2,18,200 ). Qualification required: Master's Degree with at least 55% marks in the concerned/allied subject; Cleared NET/SLET/SET or awarded a Ph.D Degree. Pay: Level - 10 (Rs. 57,700 to Rs. 1,82,400 ). Qualification required: Master's Degree in Economics - Public Finance with 55% marks, NET/SLET/SET or Ph.D. Pay: Level - 10 (Rs. 57,700 to Rs. 1,82,400 ).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Basic pay applicable is 55% of 7th CPC and 45% of 6th CPC, as the ICSSR salary grant is restricted to these percentages. Post at serial number 3 is a contract position for a period of three years.

content_sections.heading: How Will CESS Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of candidates for interview based on Academic Score Interview Short-listing of candidates for interview based on Academic Score as specified in UGC Guidelines 2018 Selection based on performance in interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: UG Degree certificate and Marks/Grade sheets Ph. D Degree Certificate Proof of Date of Birth Document Demonstrating Teaching Experience and/or Research Experience Publication Details Caste Certificate for Reservation Three references

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CESS Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Apply in the prescribed application format specifying required information. Enclose required degree certificates, marks/grade sheets, proof of date of birth, experience certificates, and publication details. Send the completed application by post to the Director, Centre for Economic and Social Studies on or before 15th November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: The decision of the selection committee will be final. Any form of Canvassing will be a disqualification. Reservation is applicable as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CESS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CESS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 1 Professor, 2 Assistant Professor, 1 Assistant Professor [Contract position for a period of three years].

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CESS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed application format) and send it to The Director, Centre for Economic and Social Studies, Nizamiah Observatory Campus, Begumpet, Hyderabad-500016, by post, to reach by 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Level - 14 (Rs. 1,44,200 to Rs. 2,18,200 ) for Professor, Level - 10 (Rs. 57,700 to Rs. 1,82,400 ) for Assistant Professor, Level - 10 (Rs. 57,700 to Rs. 1,82,400 ) for Assistant Professor [Contract position for a period of three years].

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ph.D in relevant discipline with required publications and experience. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants employed in Government, Semi-Government, Autonomous bodies must send applications through proper channel or produce NOC.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who canvass will be disqualified. Applications of in-service candidates not routed through proper channel are invalid.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of candidates for interview based on Academic Score. Interview. Short-listing of candidates for interview based on Academic Score as specified in UGC Guidelines 2018. Selection based on performance in interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post at serial number 3 is a contract position for a period of three years.

faq.answer: Hyderabad.
